newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Fight erupts in National Assembly.
President Lee Teng-hui reiterates willingness to visit mainland as president of Republic of China.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Thousands of residential houses in southern Chiayi flooded by torrential rains.
President Lee says Taiwan does not need to declare independence.
LIBERTY TIMES - Education ministry to experiment with allowing students to apply for colleges rather than taking standardised entrance exams.
National assembly members bloodied in brawl.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan dollar to rise against U.S. currency if money rates remain at high levels.
TI-Acer plans to invest T$100 billion in eight-inch wafer plant.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - President Lee says reunification can only be achieved under freedom, democracy and mutual benefits.
Koo Chen-fu, Taiwan representative in Hong Kong handover, will meet new Hong Kong chief Tung Chee-hwa.
